line_items.reasoning: Q1 revenue of $12.7B landed exactly at the midpoint of the guided $12.2B–$13.2B range, matching guidance precisely.
Gross margin of 45.1% came in 60 basis points above the guided ~44.5%, despite peak 5-nodes-in-4-years start-up costs pressuring the foundry segment.
Q1 EPS of $0.18 exceeded the guided $0.13 by $0.05, driven by operating spending discipline and strong sell-through of previously reserved inventory.
No specific capex figures were reported to contradict the prior guidance of rising gross CapEx in 2024 and net CapEx in the mid-30s % of revenue aggregate; no deviation was flagged.
No update contradicted the roughly breakeven adjusted free cash flow target for full-year 2024, and long-term margin targets were not revised, keeping this guidance intact.
